source.name: Oklahoma City Thunder (nba.com): Thunder, Love's Enter Multi-Year Partnership Extension
source.quote: The agreement will broaden the placement of the Love's heart logo patch beyond Thunder jerseys to include youth jerseys for the YMCA Thunder Basketball League.
source.note: The patch was first announced on 15 March 2019; this 2023 multi-year extension says the Love's heart logo patch covers Thunder jerseys. The page body is JavaScript-rendered, so scripts/check_sources.py cannot read the quote.
